meta.title: HK416 D14.5RS muzzle flash and smoke simulation
meta.frame: tables are in the muzzle frame: origin at socket_muzzle (hider face, on the bore axis), axes parallel to the gun frame (+Z down-range, +Y up, +X to the shooter's left; the rifle's right side is -X); metres. socket_muzzle_gun_frame gives its place in the gun frame.
meta.units: SI. t_ms in milliseconds after the bullet base leaves the barrel crown (see timing), t_s in seconds; lengths in mm where the key says _mm, else m; intensity_cd = luminous intensity seen side-on; luminance in cd/m2; rgb = linear sRGB with luminance 1
meta.config: D14.5RS, 14.5 in barrel, M855 (as action/), the modelled 6-slot birdcage flash hider

charge_mass.note: m_charge: M855: 26.1 gr WC844 (US Army TM 43-0001-27); varies by lot

bore_area.note: bore_area: 5.56 mm lands / 5.69 mm grooves, mean

gamma.note: gamma: ratio of specific heats of propellant gas

gas_constant.note: force_const / flame_temp, as action/sim.py defines it

ignition_after_sear.note: events.ignition: sear release to the charge alight

socket_muzzle_z.note: socket_muzzle in the gun frame (hider face, on the bore axis)

fh_len.note: fh_l0 to fh_l1 in build.py; notes/NOTES.md: 42.9 mm long

fh_chamber_r.note: inner radius of the cage (15.6 mm open mouth)

fh_crown_back.note: notes/NOTES.md: the barrel crown sits 8 mm inside the hider, so 34.9 mm behind its face

fh_slots.note: six slots, 60 deg apart, first 30 deg from top (a real A2 has 5 and a closed bottom)

fh_slot_z.note: slot ends from the hider face: build.py cuts a stadium from fh_l0 + 19.5 mm to fh_l1 - 5.5 mm

slot_cd.note: weight of the slot area against the open mouth in the MOMENTUM split. Fitted so the 16 in / 5-slot run puts the Mach disc where the TTAG A2 photo shows the upstream face of the glow (123 mm, +-12): nearly all the axial momentum stays in the mouth jet

slot_mass_cd.note: discharge weight of the slot area against the open mouth for the MASS that leaves through the slots (the slots bleed the edge of the jet; its fast core goes straight on, so mass and momentum split differently)

slot_lean_deg.note: slot jets lean forward; angle from the bore, from the slot-jet blob in the TTAG A2 photo (+-10 deg)

mach_disk_c.note: x_M/D = 0.69 M_e sqrt(gamma p_e/p_inf): Lewis & Carlson (1964) form of the Mach disc distance of an under-expanded jet

slot_reach_cal.note: slot-jet glow sits about 50 mm from its slot in the TTAG A2 photo; the round-jet law scaled to the slot share gives less (sheet jets are not round jets)

disk_d_over_x.note: width of the glow behind the Mach disc / disc distance: fitted to the height of the glow in the TTAG A2 photo (30 mm at the photo's clip level). Steady-jet Mach discs are 0.4 to 0.5 of their distance across, so the bright core is narrower than the disc

establish_exp.note: while the shock still rides the bullet base it is only bullet-wide and faint; glow factor (x_disk / x_steady)^n. Fitted: the A2 photo is dark between the muzzle and the disc at its furthest

slot_glow_size.note: slot-jet glow is smaller than a round jet of the same flow would give (photo blob about 12 mm across)

slot_glow_factor.note: slot-jet glow against the main glow per unit area, fitted to the blob above the hider in the TTAG A2 photo (thin sheet jets, oblique shocks)

front_speed_k.note: gas front first outruns the bullet: initial front speed / muzzle velocity (the schlieren still shows the bullet inside the cloud)

front_t_decel.note: front decelerates as x = a t / sqrt(1 + t/t_d); t_d fitted so the glow can reach as far down-range as the TTAG A2 photo shows (about 170 to 185 mm)

glow_len_over_x.note: length of the luminous plume behind the disc / disc distance (TTAG A2 photo)

soot_kappaY.note: grey absorption of particulates per kg of gas (about 1 % soot at 5 m2/g)

dT_chem.note: air burning into the shocked gas (intermediate flash): line reversal 1600 rising to 1940 K in a 7.62 mm rifle (Klingenberg & Mach 1976)

flush_k.note: the burning behind the Mach disc dies away once the disc has reached its furthest point, with time constant flush_k * x_max / v_muzzle (the air caught between the blast and the jet is used up). Fitted to the dark gap between muzzle and glow in the TTAG A2 photo

glow_floor.note: shocked gas that is not burning glows at this fraction of what its temperature and particulate load would give. Fitted to the dark gap in the TTAG A2 photo: the visible intermediate flash is mostly the burning

T_secondary.note: Klingenberg & Mach 1976: secondary flash about 2500 K (7.62 mm rifle); taken a little lower for the smaller fireball

sec_rise.note: secondary flash pulse I ~ (t/tr) exp(1 - t/tr)

sec_hider_scale.note: a secondary flash that does light through the hider is a partial one (see the photo comparison: the two service photos bracket it)

T_ignite_sigma.note: shot-to-shot spread used to turn the margin into a probability

anchor_lux_a2.note: TTAG flash hider shootout: A2 birdcage 0.48 lx with 0.25 lx ambient

anchor_lux_bare.note: TTAG flash hider shootout: bare muzzle 10,760 lx

anchor_dist.note: the TTAG meter stood beside the muzzle; about two feet is read off their set-up photo, not stated to the centimetre

anchor_tau.note: peak-hold lux meter modelled as first order with a 10 ms response (typical of hand-held meters; TTAG does not give it)

smoke_mass_frac.note: particulate (soot, K salts, primer and jacket metal) / charge mass

smoke_kext.note: visible mass extinction coefficient of the particulate

smoke_albedo.note: single-scatter albedo: grey-white, slightly blue in thin layers

entrain_alpha.note: puff entrainment coefficient (turbulent puffs and thermals: 0.25 to 0.3, Turner 1973)

ambient_spread.note: slow growth of the puff radius by ambient turbulence

gas_block_frac.note: share of gas vented at the piston gas block

eject_frac.note: share of smoke leaving the ejection port (piston gun: small, manual p.11)

timing.note: from action/: the charge ignites 8.51 ms after the sear releases the hammer and the bullet base leaves the crown 0.976 ms after that. Every t_ms table in this file counts from bullet exit; HK416Flash takes time from ignition and adds the offset. The 41 microseconds the bullet base then spends inside the hider cage are not resolved.

drive.source: ../action/action.json and ../action/sim.py (ib_solve): Resal energy balance, Nobel-Abel gas, Lagrange gradient; after exit the bore empties as an isentropic reservoir through a sonic muzzle

bullet_exit.note: action/ empties the bore as a reservoir holding the whole charge as gas at the mean pressure; its temperature there (1797 K) is what this simulation takes as the stagnation temperature of the muzzle flow. Just before exit action/ prints 1956 K for the burnt fraction alone (92.6 %); the step is its own change of book-keeping, kept as it is.

check_against_action_json.note: the bore state used here against the numbers printed in action/action.json (same model, re-run through action/sim.py ib_solve with the stored calibration)

velocity_check.note: the same model at the manual's other barrel lengths (HK manual p. 7). It shows how far the 16 in reference run behind the photo and light-meter comparisons can be trusted.

gas_composition_mole_fraction.source: inferred: typical frozen muzzle composition of a double-base ball powder (fuel-rich: CO + H2 over half). Used only for the wording of the secondary flash and the water-vapour figure.

blowdown.model: action/sim.py: isentropic emptying of the bore reservoir through a sonic muzzle. p0 and T0 are the reservoir state; mass flow is the choked-nozzle flow of that state; thrust is action's bore force after exit (scaled there to the SAAMI gas momentum)

jet.note: x measured from the hider face along the bore; slot_disk_dist along each slot jet from its slot. Cell pattern: one barrel shock and Mach disc per jet; behind the disc the gas is subsonic at about the reservoir temperature; weaker cells further out are not resolved.

precursor.note: air and blow-by pushed out ahead of the bullet (about -0.3 to 0 ms). Weak red glow; not simulated, no light assigned.

primary.what: gas stagnating in the front of the cage, seen through the slots and the mouth

intermediate.what: muzzle glow: gas re-heated behind the Mach disc of the mouth jet, with some air burning in (intermediate flash)
intermediate.shape: sharp bright face at start_z (the Mach disc), tapering down-range over length; width is the disc diameter

slot_jet.what: the same glow behind the small Mach disc of each of the six slot jets (per slot)

secondary.what: re-ignition of the fuel-rich gas in air: a fireball. Suppressed on most shots by the hider.
secondary.note: intensity_cd_full is the full fireball, its peak set by the TTAG bare-muzzle reading of 10,760 lx; through the hider a secondary flash is usually partial (hider_scale, inferred). Final sizes are fitted to the two service photos in REFERENCES.md (full: 103rd Rescue Squadron M4; partial: Marine M4A1 at dusk); the growth law is inferred. length and diameter are the envelope of the fireball; the part brighter than a quarter of the peak is about half as big.

sparks.what: residual sparks: burning grains and hot metal thrown down-range
sparks.source: inferred from streaks in the cited dusk and night-vision photos; not simulated

spectra.unit: W m-2 sr-1 nm-1 at t = 0.2 ms (secondary: at its own temperature, emissivity 0.05)
spectra.note: grey particulate continuum at the phase temperature; Na and K resonance lines and CaOH/CuOH bands fill toward the blackbody ceiling. Feature strengths are inferred; the species are published. The K doublet at 766/770 nm carries much of the near-infrared signature (bright in night vision) but little visible light.

light.what: point light for the game: luminous intensity (cd) and colour of the whole flash without a secondary flash

frame60.note: the whole flash spread over one 1/60 s frame (same luminous energy)

smoke.what: particulate and condensate plume as entraining puffs. Positions in the muzzle frame.
smoke.condensate_note: about 0.27 g of water vapour leaves with the gas; it condenses to a white mist only in cold or humid air (not simulated; raise opacity up to 3x for a cold-weather look, inferred)

sources.name: muzzle_wisp
sources.note: inferred: slow hot gas left in the bore curls out after the jet

sources.name: gas_block_vent
sources.note: inferred: short-stroke piston vents at the gas block (152 mm behind the muzzle in the model)

sources.name: ejection_port
sources.note: inferred: chamber gas trailing the case; socket_eject. Piston gun, so small (manual p.11)

smoke.opacity_rule: optical depth through a puff at impact parameter b: tau = tau_centre * exp(-b^2 / (2 (R/2)^2)), tau_centre = kext * smoke_mass * share / (2 pi (R/2)^2); opacity = 1 - exp(-tau)

wake.note: each source is drawn as a head puff (head_share of its smoke, at the track position) plus stem puffs at these fractions of the way from the source to the head, radius = R (floor + (1 - floor) f). Inferred closure.

smoke.wind_note: wind enters through entrainment: the air a puff swallows carries the wind momentum. HK416Flash.smoke(t, wind) and physics.puff_track(src, t, wind) run the same sums.

parity.note: computed by sim.py straight from physics.py; test_flash.js asks hk416-flash.js for the same things. Times are seconds since ignition; positions in the muzzle frame.

photometric_calibration.note: all thermal intensities are multiplied by this factor so the 16 in / A2 run reproduces the TTAG reading of 0.23 lx above ambient at 0.61 m on a 10 ms peak-hold meter
